Theme

round noun

one stage of a game or contest

also round of a game, another round, the next round, heat, bout, inning

classical

Suet. Dom. 4.3: centum missūs
Suet. Ner. 22: multiplicātīs missibus (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. inning, heat, round
Traupman 45
Traupman 333

missus, missūs m.

noun, fourth declension

a heat, a round (of races or games)

Properly the start, when the chariots were let go; then each race of a day at the circus.

Other words

  • congressus, congressūs m. — a bout, a round (in boxing)

    noun, fourth declension · also used · modern · Traupman 46: congressū vincere, win a round

    Classically a meeting, and an encounter in a fight (Lewis & Short).

  • orbis, orbis m. — a round of turns, a rotation

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Liv. 1.17.6: per omnēs in orbem ībat

    in orbem, in turn, round the circle.

Examples

  • circēnsium diē, quō facilius centum missūs peragerentur, singulōs ē septēnīs spatiīs ad quīna corripuit

    on the day of the circus games, so that a hundred races could be got through more easily, he cut each from seven laps to fiveSuet. Dom. 4.3

  • quīnque diērum spatiō fīniēbātur imperium ac per omnēs in orbem ībat

    each held power for five days, and it went round them all in turnLiv. 1.17.6

See also competition, game, race, in turn, your turn, round.
